xmldoc.short_description: Create and load an empty nflow model.

param_input_item.param_description: a string: a valid model identifier. When omitted, an automatic name is generated (untitled, untitled1, ...).

param_output_item.param_description: a double: a handle to the loaded model.

description.p: new_system creates an empty nflow model and registers it as loaded. The model is addressed later either by its returned handle or by its name.
Blocks are added with add_block, connected with add_line or NFlow.connectBlocks, configured with set_param, saved with save_system and opened in the editor with open_system.
